response.original_title: 【Ultimate™-Support】 How to communicate on Celestyal Cruise?
response.overview: You can communicate on a Celestyal Cruise by downloading the Celestyal Cruises mobile app for onboard guest chat, using cabin stateroom landlines, or purchasing a paid Wi-Fi package for internet access. Contact or Call +1-855-732-4023 (US/Canada) +44-289-708-0062 (UK)  Onboard Communication Options Celestyal App: Connect to the ship's Wi-Fi (leave your phone on airplane mode) to use the complimentary or low-cost guest chat feature to talk with other passengers or reach guest services. Stateroom Phones: Use your cabin telephone to call other staterooms or reception desks. Paid Wi-Fi Packages: Buy an internet package to use standard messaging apps like WhatsApp, iMessage, or email to connect with people back home. In-Cabin Tablets: Each cabin provides a tablet for checking daily schedules, ship info, and booking onboard experiences.
